description: This file defines the PredefinedChart class, which includes methods for generating SQL queries related to predefined charts within the SuiteCRM system. It handles various chart types such as pipeline by sales stage, lead source by outcome, outcome by month, lead source by lead source, and module usage in the last 30 days.

classes.name: PredefinedChart
classes.description: A class providing methods to generate SQL queries for various predefined charts within SuiteCRM, such as sales pipeline, lead sources, outcomes, and module usage.

methods.name: predefinedChartQuery
methods.description: Main method that returns the SQL query corresponding to a specified chart type, routing to specific query methods based on the chart name.

methods.name: pipelineBySalesStageQuery
methods.description: Constructs SQL query for the 'pipeline_by_sales_stage' chart, retrieving opportunity counts and totals grouped by sales stage, filtered by user preferences and request parameters.

methods.name: leadSourceByOutcomeQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL query for 'lead_source_by_outcome' chart, aggregating opportunity amounts and counts by lead source and sales stage, with filtering.

methods.name: outcomeByMonthQuery
methods.description: Prepares SQL for 'outcome_by_month' chart, summarizing opportunity amounts over months within user-specified date ranges.

methods.name: pipelineByLeadSourceQuery
methods.description: Generates SQL for 'pipeline_by_lead_source' chart, aggregating opportunities by lead source and filtering by user and date ranges.

methods.name: myModuleUsageLast30Days
methods.description: Creates SQL query to list module usage counts for the current user over the last 30 days.

methods.name: customChartQuery
methods.description: Attempts to load a custom PHP script for chart query generation from 'custom/Charts/' directory.
